description: Twelve full-horizon paired trials of requested-target and controller-limit-aware prerequisite/handback guards on the diagnosed Jar scene, at roots zero, one and two.
rationale: Episode 45 of jar-guard-repeat-v2 lifted an open held jar at observation 1873. The guard predicted downward motion from a second-joint target beyond its lower limit; reconstructing controller output clipping changes the estimate upward and agrees in sign with measured motion. Offline regression shows the corrected estimate blocks that recorded proposal, not that a physical rollout is repaired.
scope: One engineering scene chosen after diagnosis. Compare correction enabled versus disabled within each guard kind; do not claim broad generalization or a gain over unguarded identity. Repeated original guards are contemporaneous controls because earlier same-seed physical starts can differ. No optimizer or reserved scenes.
controls: Same frozen checkpoint, horizon, privileged prerequisite/contact/holding information, guard trigger margin and confirmations, query schedule, and handback settings within each pair. Only guard_joint_limits changes. Bounds are robot controller configuration, not additional object state. All four physical outcomes and query costs remain required.
activation: After unchanged Lid v1 finishes normally and all 16 results/costs validate, activate the isolated tested code and switch the idle policy to Jar. Require a fresh 32-action corrected-guard reference with live limits and a six-query strict interleaved replay before these full trials.
accounting: Count all 12 complete or failed attempts and any reference/replay work separately. Full original 2000-action horizons; no rollback or shortened outcome scoring. A missed reproduction or lack of safe completion remains a reported result.
